root_cause.text: The `bond_header_parse()` function uses `skb->dev` to identify the device for parsing, but in a stacked bonding configuration, `skb->dev` always points to the top-level bonding device, causing infinite recursion when the slave is also a bonding device whose own `parse` method is called again on the same top-level device.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description says "bond_header_parse() can loop if a stack of two bonding devices is setup, because skb->dev always points to the hierarchy top." The patch adds a `const struct net_device *dev` parameter to `header_ops->parse()` and modifies `bond_header_parse()` to pass `slave->dev` instead of `skb->dev` when calling the slave's parse function, thereby bounding recursion and ensuring the leaf parse method is invoked.
